timecoded_text_to_speech.text: My name is Demetrius and welcome to Astro Demetrius, a channel dedicated to astronomy in Python.
Here you'll be able to find structural videos on topics in astronomy such as sunspots, planets, galaxies and much more.
These videos support the Jupiter notebook activities linked in the description below.
You might also see unique challenge videos where we solve an astronomy related problem with Python.
If you are new to Python, check out my intro videos on Python and Matplotlib.
Otherwise, dive right in and remember, stay stellar.

youtube_description:
Welcome to astroDimitrios a channel dedicated to Astronomy in Python.

These videos support the notebook activities on my GitHub here:
